name: pro-design
description: Frontend design skills. Build: emil-design-eng (start here for components and screens), landing-page-design (single-CTA conversion landing page with a visual system), build-awwwards-quality-sites (immersive scroll-storytelling marketing sites), apple-design (Apple HIG principles). Motion: animate (add or refine animation on an already built site), animation-vocabulary (turn vague motion words into exact animation terms), motion (Framer Motion implementation + discipline), motion-system. Review and fix: screen-critique with the /critique-screen command (judge a rendered screen against seven critique lenses), interface-review (review UI changes in a PR, branch, or working tree with regression detection), better-interface (the holistic consolidation and verdict layer over the better-* family; uninstalled domains report as Not reviewed), better-layout (spacing, alignment, and grouping to the pixel), perception-laws (Gestalt laws, Von Restorff, visual hierarchy), accessibility-audit (WCAG 2.2 POUR). Systems: design tokens, typography scale, shadcn/ui composition, stitch-skill (create/update DESIGN.MD), taste-skill (targeted visual polish pass). Bridges (not vendored): impeccable-bridge for the full end-to-end UI/UX pass via /design-engine, taste-skills-bridge for the Leonxlnx anti-slop, visual-style, image-gen, and brand-kit library via /taste-skills, plus web-design-engineer-bridge (reference-grounded HTML artifacts, style recipes, design scoring), tastemaker-bridge (extract tokens from a reference image's real pixels and lock the style across a project), and mengto-skills-bridge (scroll storytelling, WebGL and shader effects, video-to-superprompt) - all three installed with the /design-skills command. Install figma from claude-plugins-official via install-companions.sh.
